notes: Financial Systems & FinTech, E-commerce, Retail & POS, CMS & Headless CMS, News & Media, Hospital Management & EHR, and Clinic Management each have ten source-reviewed candidates with provisional scores. Booking & Service Marketplaces has six suitable, source-reviewed candidates; the narrower count avoids padding.

OpenELIS Global is included only as a clinic-adjacent diagnostic/LIS subsystem, not a general practice-management EHR; Medplum is infrastructure for custom clinical software, not a turnkey clinic product.
